in_sanskrit.name: श्रीनिवास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (Shri) - Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity; निवास (Nivas) - Abode, Residence. So, Srinivas means the 'Abode of Goddess Shri' or 'Lord of Wealth and Prosperity'.

in_hindi.name: श्रीनिवास
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्री (Shri) - Respected, Beloved; निवास (Nivas) - Abode, Residence. So, Srinivas means 'Respected, Beloved Abode' or 'Lord of Wealth and Prosperity'.

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீநிவாஸ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஶ்ரீ (Shri) - Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity; நிவாஸ் (Nivas) - Abode, Residence. So, Srinivas means 'Abode of Goddess Shri' or 'Lord of Great Wealth and Prosperity'.

in_telugu.name: శ్రీనివాశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శ్రీ (Shri) - Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity; నివాశ్ (Nivas) - Abode, Residence. So, Srinivas means 'Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity's Abode' or 'Lord of Wealth and Prosperity'.

vedic_reference.note: Srinivas is a name of Lord Vishnu. He is also known as Govinda or Hari. Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe in Hinduism.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Srinivas" is greatly revered in Hinduism, as it reminds us of the deep devotion and connection Indians have towards Lord Vishnu. The name literally translates to "one who has Lord Vishnu in his heart," signifying the inner devotion and reverence for the deity. This name holds a rich cultural significance, as Vishnu is the preserver of the universe in Hindu mythology, and is known for his compassion, grace, and power.— Shreyas
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Srinivas" is deeply rooted in the principles of dharma and devotion. The term "Sri" in the name denotes the divine grace and blessings of Goddess Lakshmi and Savitri, while "Nivas" signifies one's dwelling or home. Together, the name represents the idea of having God reside in one's heart. It is a constant reminder to seek and maintain the inner presence of the divine, and to live a life guided by dharma, compassion, and selfless service. It is a reminder that the ultimate goal of human life is to become a vessel for the divine and to fulfill one's spiritual potential.— Aakriti US.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Srinivas was a popular name in the Vedic period, meaning 'abounding in wealth'. The name Srinivas carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Used as a surname in India and the US
modern_usage.modern_context: Srinivas is a common name in India and is also used as a surname in India and the US. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'srinivasa', which means 'abounding in wealth'. In modern times, the name has gained popularity on various platforms such as social media and email addresses.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Maya Srinivas in Delhi, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Srinivas, which means "Lord of Wealth, Auspiciousness, Grace". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Srinivas means "Abode of Lakshmi (Goddess of Wealth) and Narayana (Vishnu)". It symbolizes the inner sought union of material prosperity and spiritual growth.
